title: A localization of a regular local ring at a prime is a regular local ring
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a regular local ring [def-weil-regular-scheme] and $\mathfrak p\subset R$ a prime ideal. Then the localization $R_{\mathfrak p}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] is a regular local ring. Consequently every regular local ring is a regular ring in the sense of [def-weil-regular-scheme] (all its localizations at primes are regular local rings).

proof.text: R is Noetherian and local by IsRegularLocalRing [def-weil-regular-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. For any prime q, Mathlib supplies the Noetherian instance for Localization q.primeCompl (IsLocalization.isNoetherianRing [lem-weil-pbc-localization-noetherian]) and the local-ring instance for Localization.AtPrime q [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. No explicit instance construction is needed.

proof.text: Mathlib supplies FiniteRingKrullDim R for Noetherian local rings, via Krulls height theorem. Since ringKrullDim R is neither bottom nor top, WithBot.ne_bot_iff_exists and ENat.ne_top_iff_exists give a natural number d with ringKrullDim R = d (including d = 0). Apply IsRegularLocalRing.hasGlobalDimensionLE_of_ringKrullDim_eq [lem-weil-pbc-regular-local-finite-gl-dim] to obtain Ring.HasGlobalDimensionLE R d [def-weil-pbc-finite-global-dimension].

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 0AFS (lemma-localization-of-regular-local-is-regular, line 27126), proof, first sentence (direction 'regular local implies finite global dimension' via Proposition Tag 00O7)

proof.text: For each prime q, apply the global-dimension implication (part 2.1) of Ring.localization_preserves_projective_and_global_dimension [lem-weil-pbc-localization-finite-gl-dim] to q.primeCompl and d. This gives Ring.HasGlobalDimensionLE (Localization.AtPrime q) d [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. The pair of d and that proof gives finite global dimension [def-weil-pbc-finite-global-dimension].

proof.text: Apply IsRegularLocalRing.of_hasFiniteGlobalDimension [lem-weil-pbc-finite-gl-dim-regular-local] to the Noetherian local ring Localization.AtPrime q and the finite-global-dimension proof. This gives regular localness [def-weil-regular-scheme] uniformly for every prime q.
